description: This file contains a test class 'OrganizationDaoTest' which verifies the functionality of the Organization Data Access Object (DAO) in the OrangeHRM system. The class includes setup routines and test methods for retrieving and saving organization information, utilizing mock data and asserting expected behaviors.

classes.name: OrganizationDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that tests the Organization DAO functionalities such as retrieving and saving organization info within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test by instantiating DAO objects and populating test data from configuration files.

methods.name: testGetOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Tests that retrieving general organization information returns an Organization instance.

methods.name: testSaveOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Tests saving a new organization's general information and verifies that related subunit data is updated accordingly.
